evidence_uri_note: evidence:/ paths resolve relative to evidence_root. Full raw traces and frozen binaries remain local outside the source repository.

provenance.host: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 16 logical CPUs, approximately 64 GiB RAM
provenance.compiler_memory: Each cell is the median across 3 independent runs; each run uses the median of 3 samples 2 s apart after a 5 s warmup. PSS increment includes clients and compositor minus the empty compositor.
provenance.allocator_app_memory: Same per-run aggregation, early samples at 5/7/9 s and settled samples at 30/32/34 s after launch; 3 repetitions each.
provenance.cpu_timing: Median of per-run p95 from 3 alternating one-test-thread runs, fixed fonts, no competing compiler processes. Offscreen event/layout/raster/damage allocation costs, not end-to-end input-to-display latency.
provenance.excluded_timing: One dynamic-std Settei run with 44% host CPU, one jemalloc-background Soroban run overlapping rustc, and one wallpaper pair with 34% host CPU replaced; originals retained in raw evidence.
provenance.allocator_control: Frozen intermediate image/JPEG fixes plus rejected index shrink, identical in allocator arms; 3 allocator packages added, 249 shared reachable features unchanged, 520 locked identities preserved.
limitations: PSS excludes unmapped file cache, kernel allocations and GPU memory outside mappings; unrelated mappings affect apportioned shared pages.
Some memory samples overlapped builds; no CPU claims from those samples. No swap in compiler or app allocator sampled processes.
Shell decay curves and source memory ranges have small n explicitly recorded; no guaranteed long-session savings.
Original user report used older 35f3015 and different hardware; do not subtract old/new absolute totals.

source_findings.status: Complete accepted shell/source findings, including final quiet wallpaper confirmation.
source_findings.units: PSS/anonymous footprint MiB (2^20 bytes). Heaptrack live allocation figures MB decimal (10^6 bytes). Shell-only footprint; compositor excluded.

source_changes.change: Retain prepared Picture ownership until hide/replacement/close; consume first-frame reuse flag without dropping Image owners inside draw callback.
source_changes.benefit: Fixes ForgetImages queued before Paint, which left orphan image pixels live in renderer cache. Subsequent frames still repaint widgets.

source_changes.change: Resample JPEG Rgb8 directly; add opaque alpha only at output. Preserve existing path for all other formats.
source_changes.benefit: Same pixels with less transient memory and less filtering work.

source_changes.change: Reserve exact entry count during index construction when found.len() is already known.
source_changes.benefit: Avoid vector growth while constructing index; no load parser or shrink change retained.

heap_attribution.workload: 8 palette open/dismiss cycles,2seconds apart; synthetic230772-entry index; headless2880x1800@2; raw Heaptrack and offline interpretation.
heap_attribution.caveat: Heaptrack calls live-at-exit allocations leaks, but forced termination captures live heap without normal teardown. Baseline trace grouped3apps; patched trace shell-only with now-removed index shrink. Allocation-site offscreen bytes directly establish ownership-fix effect; index is dropped before snapshot. Wholeprocess PSS uses later exactfeature/no-shrink controls below. Lifetime allocation call counts are not live block counts.

wallpaper.workload: Same prebuilt helper contains original and patched prepare paths, same counting allocator; installed nightJPEG resized2880x1800;7 alternating pairs.
wallpaper.timing_status: Final timing is accepted quiet7pair repeat with alternating order; no builders. One briefly noisy original pair excluded and replaced. Earlier buildwindow timing retained only as supporting data.
wallpaper.quality: Exact RGBA byte equality for both installed wallpapers at2880x1800; tests cover8 EXIF orientations, grayscaleJPEG and8/16-bit alphaPNG.

context.exclusion: Both original pair4 samples excluded after brief34% hostCPU activity; replacement pair accepted.

footprint_method.build: Same Rust compiler,release-lto/thinLTO,cgu4,shell-only Cargo featureselection. Baseline frozen original source; final contains cache/JPEG changes and no load shrink.
footprint_method.workload: 8 palette open/dismiss cycles2seconds apart; private copied settings/cache/runtime; headlessPixman2880x1800@2. Per-run settled value is median of samples starting2seconds afterlastdismiss; n counts independent shell runs, not samples.
footprint_method.controls: Exact pinned fixture bytes; identical settings/key hashes; sharedflock benchmark coordination. User desktop never restarted. Prior featuremismatched, changing-current-index, and shared-fixed-executable contaminated snapshots excluded/repeated.
footprint_method.timing_limit: CLI IPC round-trip is request acknowledgement, not firstpixel latency; footprint runs may overlap compilation, so workload CPU observations are not a quiet responsiveness guarantee.

scaled_index.conclusion: Default-glibc PSS ranges overlap. Freed logical cache bytes can remain resident in allocator arenas, so liveheap reduction is not an equal resident-memory reduction.

glibc_mmap_experiment.conclusion: Resident memory reduction is substantial in this workload, but the separate matched-source offscreen CPU matrix shows material regressions; no default policy change adopted.

hidden_picture_integration.checks: Pixel equality, first-frame damage, hidden/show lifecycle, changed contents and caret behavior.

validation.review: Independent review of wallpaper format/orientation/limits and Picture lifecycle by release_profiling; no blocker.
validation.deployment: Production changes committed on codex/memory-overhead. No deployment or real-session restart; isolated test processes cleaned.

source_findings.scope_caveat: User report was older35f3015 on32GiB hardware; current installedfcdb02f on64GiB and current source snapshot differ. Synthetic matching-count fixture is not the original index; absolute old-report budgets cannot be directly compared.
